papers.title: Selective Laser Melting Produced Ti-6Al-4V: Post-Process Heat Treatments to Achieve Superior Tensile Properties
papers.abstract: Current post-process heat treatments applied to selective laser melting produced Ti-6Al-4V do not achieve the same microstructure and therefore superior tensile behaviour of thermomechanical processed wrought Ti-6Al-4V. Due to the growing demand for selective laser melting produced parts in industry, research and development towards improved mechanical properties is ongoing. This study is aimed at developing post-process annealing strategies to improve tensile behaviour of selective laser melting produced Ti-6Al-4V parts. Optical and electron microscopy was used to study α grain morphology as a function of annealing temperature, hold time and cooling rate. Quasi-static uniaxial tensile tests were used to measure tensile behaviour of different annealed parts. It was found that elongated α'/α grains can be fragmented into equiaxial grains through applying a high temperature annealing strategy. It is shown that bi-modal microstructures achieve a superior tensile ductility to current heat treated selective laser melting produced Ti-6Al-4V samples.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论了增材制造钛合金的热处理对拉伸性能的影响，但未涉及医用植入物的应力遮挡或多孔结构设计，仅作为背景参考。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, porous structures, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过后处理退火改善SLM Ti-6Al-4V的拉伸性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同温度、保温时间和冷却速率的退火策略，结合显微组织和拉伸测试。
summary_zh.result: 双态显微组织显著提高了材料的拉伸延展性。
summary_zh.validation: 准静态单轴拉伸实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop post-process heat treatments that achieve superior tensile behavior in selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V compared to conventional wrought material.
summary_en.method: Annealing strategies with varying temperature, hold time, and cooling rate were applied, followed by microstructural analysis and quasi-static uniaxial tensile tests.
summary_en.result: Bi-modal microstructures achieved superior tensile ductility compared to current heat-treated selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V samples.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was conducted via optical and electron microscopy and quasi-static uniaxial tensile tests.

papers.title: Prof. Gwo-Chin Lee: exploring new techniques and approaches in hip and knee surgery
papers.abstract: Prof. Gwo-Chin Lee, associate professor of Orthopaedic Surgery at the Presbyterian Medical Center of Philadelphia, is a well-known surgeon who has contributed a lot in the research of THA (total hip arthroplasty) and TKA (total knee arthroplasty). We are honored to know more about his work via this interview conducted in the 12th International Congress of Chinese Orthopaedic Association held in November 2017.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是临床手术访谈，不涉及任何髋关节植入物生物力学建模或有限元分析内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper contains no biomechanics modeling, no implant design, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 访谈著名髋膝关节外科医生的临床经验和技术，作为综述背景信息。
summary_zh.method: 以问答形式记录外科医生的观点和临床经验。
summary_zh.result: 无新的研究结果，仅为医生个人观点总结。

summary_en.motivation: To present an interview with an experienced orthopedic surgeon on new techniques in hip and knee arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: The paper is an interview transcript with questions and answers covering clinical experience and surgical approaches.
summary_en.result: No quantitative or experimental results; it is a summary of the surgeon's perspectives.
summary_en.validation: No validation; it is an opinion piece without data.
